subject: general
question: Who among the following became the fastest batsman to score 5000 runs in the IPL?
solution:
The correct answer is __**David Warner.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **David Warner**

 
 
• David Warner is an** Australian international cricketer.**
 
• He was a former captain of the Australian national team in limited overs format.
 
• He is a** left-handed opening batsman.**
 
• He is considered one of the best batters of the current era.
 
• He plays for **New South Wales** and played for the** Sydney Thunder** in domestic cricket.
 
• He served as the** Australian vice-captain** across Test and ODI formats of the game between 2015 and 2018.
 
• He became the fastest batsman to score** 5000 runs in the IPL.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Suresh Raina**

 
 
• Suresh Raina is a** former Indian international cricketer.**
 
• He occasionally served as stand-in captain for the Indian men's national cricket team during the absence of the main captain.
 
• He played for **Uttarpradesh (UP) **in the domestic cricket circuit.
 
• He is a** left-handed middle-order batsman** and an **occasional off-spin bowler.**
 
• He is the first Indian batsman to hit a century in all three formats of international cricket.
 
 
 
• **MS Dhoni**
 
 
• Mahendra Singh Dhoni is an **Indian former professional cricketer.**
 
• He was** captain of the Indian national cricket tea**m in limited-overs formats from 2007 to 2017.
 
• He is a **right-handed wicket-keeper batsman.**
 
• India won ICC Test Championship Mace two times in 2010, and 2011 under his leadership. 
 
 
 
• **Rohit Sharma**
 
 
• Rohit Sharma is the **current captain **of the Indian national team.
 
• He is a **right-handed opening batsman.**
 
• He plays for **Mumbai** in domestic cricket.
 
• He captains Mumbai Indians in the Indian Premier League.
 
• He holds the world record for the highest individual score** (264) in a one-day international match.**
